content.json:
# Azure SLA
Resource availability, service health incidents, and health timeline — powered by Azure Resource Graph.

> Companion to the PowerShell script **Get-AzureSLAReport.ps1**.

parameters.name: Regions
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines',
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets',
    'microsoft.sql/servers/databases',
    'microsoft.sql/servers',
    'microsoft.sql/managedinstances',
    'microsoft.web/sites',
    'microsoft.web/serverfarms',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
| summarize by location
| order by location asc

content.json:
### Resource Inventory
Tracked resources grouped by region and service category (Compute, SQL DB, Web Apps, Storage).

content.query:
Resources
| where '*' in ({Regions}) or location in~ ({Regions})
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines',
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets',
    'microsoft.sql/servers/databases',
    'microsoft.sql/servers',
    'microsoft.sql/managedinstances',
    'microsoft.web/sites',
    'microsoft.web/serverfarms',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
| extend ServiceCategory = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'Compute',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets', 'Compute',
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'SQL DB',
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers', 'SQL DB',
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances', 'SQL DB',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites', 'Web Apps',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', 'Web Apps',
    type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'Storage',
    'Other')
| summarize ['Resource Count'] = count() by Region = location, ['Service Category'] = ServiceCategory
| order by Region asc, ['Service Category'] asc
content.noDataMessage: No tracked resources found in the selected regions.

content.json:
### Current Health Availability
Real-time availability from Azure Resource Health. Matches the service categories tracked by the PowerShell script.

content.query:
HealthResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| where '*' in ({Regions}) or location in~ ({Regions})
| extend availabilityState = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| extend resourceType = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceType))
| where resourceType in~ (
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines',
    'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets',
    'microsoft.sql/servers/databases',
    'microsoft.sql/servers',
    'microsoft.sql/managedinstances',
    'microsoft.web/sites',
    'microsoft.web/serverfarms',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
| extend ServiceCategory = case(
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'Compute',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets', 'Compute',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'SQL DB',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers', 'SQL DB',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances', 'SQL DB',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.web/sites', 'Web Apps',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', 'Web Apps',
    resourceType =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'Storage',
    'Other')
| summarize
    Available = countif(availabilityState =~ 'Available'),
    Unavailable = countif(availabilityState =~ 'Unavailable'),
    Degraded = countif(availabilityState =~ 'Degraded'),
    Unknown = countif(availabilityState =~ 'Unknown'),
    Total = count()
  by Region = location, ['Service Category'] = ServiceCategory
| extend ['Availability %'] = iff(Total > 0, round(todouble(Available) / todouble(Total) * 100.0, 2), 0.0)
| order by Region asc, ['Service Category'] asc
content.noDataMessage: No Resource Health data available for the selected regions.

content.json:
### Service Health Incidents
Service issues (outages) reported in the selected time range. Columns match the **Incidents & Alerts** tab of the Excel report.

content.query:
servicehealthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events'
| where tostring(properties.EventType) =~ 'ServiceIssue'
| extend impactStartTicks = tolong(properties.ImpactStartTime)
| extend impactEndTicks = tolong(properties.ImpactMitigationTime)
| extend impactStart = iff(isnotnull(impactStartTicks) and impactStartTicks > 0, datetime_add('tick', impactStartTicks, datetime(0001-01-01)), datetime(null))
| extend impactEnd = iff(isnotnull(impactEndTicks) and impactEndTicks > 0, datetime_add('tick', impactEndTicks, datetime(0001-01-01)), datetime(null))
| where isnotnull(impactStart)
| where impactStart >= datetime_add('month', -{MonthsBack}, now())
| extend Title = tostring(properties.Title)
| extend Status = tostring(properties.Status)
| extend Level = tostring(properties.EventLevel)
| extend Summary = tostring(properties.Summary)
| mv-expand impact = properties.Impact
| extend ImpactedService = tostring(impact.ImpactedService)
| mv-expand impactedRegion = impact.ImpactedRegions
| extend ImpactedRegionName = tostring(impactedRegion.ImpactedRegion)
| summarize
    AffectedServices = make_set(ImpactedService),
    AffectedRegions = make_set(ImpactedRegionName)
  by ['Tracking ID'] = name, Title, Status, Level, Summary, impactStart, impactEnd
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', impactEnd, impactStart)
| project
    ['Tracking ID'],
    Status,
    Title,
    ['Impact Start (UTC)'] = format_datetime(impactStart, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
    ['Impact End (UTC)'] = iff(isnotnull(impactEnd), format_datetime(impactEnd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'Ongoing'),
    ['Duration (Hours)'] = iff(isnotnull(DurationMinutes), tostring(round(todouble(DurationMinutes) / 60.0, 2)), 'Ongoing'),
    Level,
    ['Affected Services'] = strcat_array(AffectedServices, '; '),
    ['Affected Regions'] = strcat_array(AffectedRegions, '; '),
    Summary
| order by ['Impact Start (UTC)'] desc
content.noDataMessage: No service health incidents found for the selected time range and subscriptions.

content.json:
### Service Health Timeline
Month-by-month view of **all** service health events (service issues, planned maintenance, health advisories) over the selected time range. Matches the **Health Timeline** tab of the Excel report.

content.query:
servicehealthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events'
| extend eventType = tostring(properties.EventType)
| extend impactStartTicks = tolong(properties.ImpactStartTime)
| extend impactEndTicks = tolong(properties.ImpactMitigationTime)
| extend impactStart = iff(isnotnull(impactStartTicks) and impactStartTicks > 0, datetime_add('tick', impactStartTicks, datetime(0001-01-01)), datetime(null))
| extend impactEnd = iff(isnotnull(impactEndTicks) and impactEndTicks > 0, datetime_add('tick', impactEndTicks, datetime(0001-01-01)), datetime(null))
| where isnotnull(impactStart)
| where impactStart >= datetime_add('month', -{MonthsBack}, now())
| extend Title = tostring(properties.Title)
| extend Status = tostring(properties.Status)
| extend Level = tostring(properties.EventLevel)
| extend Summary = tostring(properties.Summary)
| mv-expand impact = properties.Impact
| extend ImpactedService = tostring(impact.ImpactedService)
| mv-expand impactedRegion = impact.ImpactedRegions
| extend ImpactedRegionName = tostring(impactedRegion.ImpactedRegion)
| summarize
    AffectedServices = make_set(ImpactedService),
    AffectedRegions = make_set(ImpactedRegionName)
  by name, eventType, Title, Status, Level, Summary, impactStart, impactEnd
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', impactEnd, impactStart)
| project
    Month = format_datetime(impactStart, 'yyyy-MM'),
    ['Month Name'] = format_datetime(impactStart, 'MMM yyyy'),
    ['Event Type'] = eventType,
    Status,
    Title,
    ['Impact Start (UTC)'] = format_datetime(impactStart, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
    ['Impact End (UTC)'] = iff(isnotnull(impactEnd), format_datetime(impactEnd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'Ongoing'),
    ['Duration (Hours)'] = iff(isnotnull(DurationMinutes), tostring(round(todouble(DurationMinutes) / 60.0, 2)), 'Ongoing'),
    Level,
    ['Affected Services'] = strcat_array(AffectedServices, '; '),
    ['Affected Regions'] = strcat_array(AffectedRegions, '; '),
    Summary,
    ['Tracking ID'] = name
| order by Month desc, ['Impact Start (UTC)'] desc
content.noDataMessage: No service health events found for the selected time range and subscriptions.
